 "cells": [
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7ac2337b-27b7-42be-8888-47f4a916b0fd",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Project Title\n",
    "Customer Churn Prediction for an Energy Provider Using Machine Learning\n",
    "\n",
    "# Executive summary\n",
    "Customer churn is a major challenge for energy companies because acquiring new customers is often more expensive than retaining existing ones. This project develops a machine learning model to identify customers at risk of churn and provides insights into the factors driving departures.\n",
    "\n",
    "# Business Problem\n",
    "Churn is when a customer stops doing a business with a company. Churn prediction is a classification problem where we predict  whether a customer will:\n",
    "0 = stay(no churn),\n",
    "1 = leave(churn)\n",
    "The goal is to identify customers who are likely to leave before they actually do, so the company can take action to retain them. A company loses revenue when customers leave. By predicting which customers are likely to churn, targeted retention campaigns can be implememnted to reduce loses\n",
    "\n",
    "# Data Understanding\n",
    "The following information shows that describes major variables \n",
    "\n",
    "          FEATURE                                                         DESCRIPTION\n",
    "          net_margin                                                      profit generated by customer\n",
    "          cons_12m                                                        consumption over 12 months\n",
    "          forecast_discount_energy                                        predicted energy discount\n",
    "          tenure_days                                                     customer tenure\n",
    "          has_gas                                                         whether customer has gas service\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Data cleaning\n",
    "The data was free from missing values and duplicates. Missing values is a NULL where there was suppose to be a value and duplicates are repeated entries in a dataset. Missing values should avoided because the machine learning algorithm doesnt accept a dataset with missing values. duplicates distort our findings. The dates were in their correct datatype dates. This will help when doing feature engineering. The sales_channel, has_gas and origin_up variables were encoded, id column was dropped as it is of no use in the modeling. \n",
    "\n",
    "# Feature Engineering\n",
    "Feature engineering is the process of transforming raw data into meaningful features that improve the performance of machine learning (ML) models. Hence variables were added, modified and others dropped. New variables were added and these were tenure days(date_end - date_activ), days until contract end(date_end-today),days since modification(today - date_modif_prod) and month of activation was modified from date_activ to month. the following features were subsequently dropped, date_activ, date_end,date_modif_prod and date_renewal. Tenure days may explain churn in that the ideally, longer the entity stays with customer the less likely the customer is to churn. At the end of a contract period customers are usually likely to churn than when there is still time, the same with days_since_modification\n",
    "\n",
    "# Model Development\n",
    "Data was divided between training and testing data using train_test_split. Train test split is a machine learning technique used to evaluate a model. It divides the dataset into training set, that teaches the model and test set, to evaluat its accuracy. Random Forest is used which is a supervised machine learning method that combines the predictions of multiple individual decision trees to generate a single, highly accurate result\n",
    "\n",
    "# Model evaluation\n",
    "Accuracy: 91%\n",
    "Classification Report:\n",
    "              precision    recall  f1-score   support\n",
    "\n",
    "           0       0.91      1.00      0.95      2638\n",
    "           1       0.83      0.08      0.15       284\n",
    "\n",
    "    accuracy                           0.91      2922\n",
    "   macro avg       0.87      0.54      0.55      2922\n",
    "weighted avg       0.90      0.91      0.87      2922\n",
    "\n",
    "Confusion_matrix:\n",
    "[[2633    5]\n",
    " [ 260   24]]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Feature Importance\n",
    "Net Margin emerged as th strongest predictor of churn. Customers generating low profitability may be more likely to stay than those that have bigger margins. Customers with higher consumption are likely to stay than those with lower consuption. This phenomenon suggests that big users of energy do not want to easily switch to other supliers and not disturbing their operations by switching suppliers\n",
    "\n",
    "# Recommendations\n",
    "- Monitor customers with declining margins.\n",
    "- Offer proactive customer support before contract renewal.\n",
    "- Target low-tenure customers with retention offers.\n",
    "- Target low-tenure customers with retention offers.\n",
    "\n",
    "\n"
   ]
  },

    "from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, classification_report, confusion_matrix\n",
    "from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier"
   ]

  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "5dea73a1-5de4-478f-ba8a-43139823ce45",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Feature Engineering"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 88,
   "id": "d7170747-a547-4675-bf36-f1358e61b1a8",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#customer tenure\n",
    "df[\"tenure_days\"] = (df[\"date_end\"]-df[\"date_activ\"]).dt.days"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 89,
   "id": "82d09c6a-5f46-4d74-bee1-3b5db8152fcc",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#days until contract ends\n",
    "today=pd.Timestamp.today()\n",
    "df['days_to_end']=(df['date_end']-today).dt.days\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 90,
   "id": "201b6bd0-c52b-452d-9dba-0f8103741265",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "#month of activation\n",
    "df[\"activation_month\"] = df[\"date_activ\"].dt.month\n",
    "\n",
    "# year of activation\n",
    "df[\"activation_year\"] = df[\"date_activ\"].dt.year\n",
    "\n",
    "#days since modification\n",
    "df['days_since_modification'] = (today-df[\"date_modif_prod\"]).dt.days"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 91,
   "id": "862c4dba-b476-42f8-8282-7c78ee6eba41",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "df = df.drop([\"date_activ\",\"date_end\",\"date_modif_prod\",\"date_renewal\"],axis=1)\n"
   ]
  },

       "        </div>\n",
       "    </div></div></div></div></div><script>function copyToClipboard(text, element) {\n",
       "    // Get the parameter prefix from the closest toggleable content\n",
       "    const toggleableContent = element.closest('.sk-toggleable__content');\n",
       "    const paramPrefix = toggleableContent ? toggleableContent.dataset.paramPrefix : '';\n",
       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${text}` : text;\n",
       "\n",
       "    const originalStyle = element.style;\n",
       "    const computedStyle = window.getComputedStyle(element);\n",
       "    const originalWidth = computedStyle.width;\n",
       "    const originalHTML = element.innerHTML.replace('Copied!', '');\n",
       "\n",
       "    navigator.clipboard.writeText(fullParamName)\n",
       "        .then(() => {\n",
       "            element.style.width = originalWidth;\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'green';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Copied!\";\n",
       "\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        })\n",
       "        .catch(err => {\n",
       "            console.error('Failed to copy:', err);\n",
       "            element.style.color = 'red';\n",
       "            element.innerHTML = \"Failed!\";\n",
       "            setTimeout(() => {\n",
       "                element.innerHTML = originalHTML;\n",
       "                element.style = originalStyle;\n",
       "            }, 2000);\n",
       "        });\n",
       "    return false;\n",
       "}\n",

       "    const fullParamName = paramPrefix ? `${paramPrefix}${paramName}` : paramName;\n",
       "\n",
       "    element.setAttribute('title', fullParamName);\n",
       "});\n",
       "</script></body>"
      ],
